name: get_status
description: Is the CAAD page connected, which project and part are open, and is the CAD kernel ready. Call this first if anything fails.

name: build123d_guide
description: CAAD's guide to build123d: part file conventions, builder mode, sketches, operations, selectors and common mistakes. Read it before writing your first part. Without a topic it returns the table of contents.

topic.description: Section name from the table of contents, or 'all'

name: api_help
description: Signature and documentation of a build123d name (e.g. 'fillet', 'Box', 'ShapeList.sort_by', 'Mode'), taken from the exact build123d version the page runs. A partial name lists matching names.

name: run_snippet
description: Run Python code in the page's build123d kernel without changing any file, e.g. to try a selector or measure something. `from build123d import *` is done; the variables of the open part (after its last build) are available, and `part` is the shown shape. Returns printed output and the value of the last expression; shapes are summarised (type, volume, bounding box).

name: list_parts
description: The open folder's CAAD projects and their files by kind: parts, shared code (importable by the project's parts, e.g. params.py), assemblies, exports; and build123d files in no project. Shows where new parts go (<project>/parts/).

name: read_part
description: The source code of a part file, with line numbers.

path.description: Path relative to the open folder (the workspace), e.g. 'caad-examples/parts/bracket.py'

name: write_part
description: Create or overwrite a part file with complete source code. The page saves it, shows it to the user, rebuilds it and returns the result: OK or the error at its feature, the timeline, volume and bounding box. Prefer edit_part for small changes.

name: edit_part
description: Replace an exact piece of text in a part file (it must occur exactly once), then save, show and rebuild like write_part. Returns the build result.

name: open_part
description: Show a part in the user's view (and rebuild it). Optionally roll back to a feature index from the timeline.

rollback.description: Show the part as it is after this feature (0-based); omit for the whole part

name: get_timeline
description: The open part's timeline: one entry per feature (line range, status ok/error/skipped/rolled-back, kind, label, sketch name and the earlier features it uses), the error if any, volume and bounding box.

name: get_selection
description: What the user has selected in the view: faces/edges with type, area or length, radius, centre, normal or axis, and verified build123d selectors for them (use those in code instead of describing geometry).

name: highlight
description: Highlight geometry in the user's view, e.g. to ask 'do you mean these edges?'. The selector is evaluated against the open part, like code in the part file. An empty selector clears the highlight.

note.description: Short message shown to the user next to the highlight

name: render
description: A PNG image of the open part. 'current' is exactly what the user sees (including selection and highlights); the named views frame the whole part from that direction without moving the user's camera.
